en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a beach scene with several small sailing boats near the shore, one with a large triangular sail raised. People are working around the boats in the shallow water and on the sandy beach. In the background there is a wooden pier extending into the sea, crowded with people. Hills or dunes rise in the distance. Printed red text appears in the upper left and along the right edge, and a red handwritten number is at the top right.
